tagline: Europe's largest telecommunications infrastructure operator enabling shared-use network access
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of Points of Presence (PoPs) is the primary organic value driver for Cellnex, reflecting active integration of new equipment on existing and new sites, and materializing growing demand from telecom operators for shared infrastructure.

kpis.name: Points of Presence (PoPs) Growth
kpis.explanation: Number of new equipment installed on Cellnex sites, key to generating recurring revenue.
kpis.description: PoPs growth of +6.5% in 2024 demonstrates strong demand from telecom operators for Cellnex infrastructure.

kpis.name: EBITDA after Leases
kpis.explanation: Operating result adjusted to account for financial leases, key metric for real estate and infrastructure companies.
kpis.description: EBITDAaL reached €2.386 billion in 2024, up 10.6%, supported by organic growth and cost management.

kpis.name: Raised Recurring Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow available after debt and investments, used to reward shareholders.
kpis.description: RLFCF reached €1.796 billion in 2024, exceeding the €1.75 billion target, driven by strong cash generation.
kpis.signal: Growth of 16.2%: financial discipline and robust cash generation.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated company revenue, primarily recurring via long-term leases.
kpis.description: Revenue reached €3.941 billion in 2024, up 7.7%, driven by organic expansion and new contracts.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating result before depreciation and non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA stood at €3.25 billion in 2024, up 8%, with margin maintained at 82%.
kpis.signal: Margin stable at 82%, resilient business model.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow available after investments, key for financial flexibility.
kpis.description: FCF reached €328 million in 2024 versus €150 million in 2023, benefiting from better capex management and investment cycle.
kpis.signal: FCF doubled in one year: improved cash quality.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Final result after all expenses, depreciation and losses.
kpis.description: Net profit improved significantly to -€28 million in 2024 versus -€297 million in 2023, nearing break-even.
kpis.signal: Near break-even achieved with 90% improvement despite high depreciation and Austria impairment.

kpis.name: Customer Density Ratio per Site
kpis.explanation: Average number of customers per site, measures efficiency of shared infrastructure and asset densification.
kpis.description: Customer ratio reached 1.60x in 2024 versus 1.54x in 2023, indicating better site utilization.
kpis.signal: Increasing site densification: better asset utilization and more revenue per infrastructure.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years declared by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.371 EUR last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 3 fiscal years declared.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.012 billion EUR last year.

kpis.name: Projected Revenue 2025
kpis.explanation: Expected revenue in 2025 after deconsolidation of Austria and Ireland, pro-forma basis.
kpis.description: 2025 revenue expected between €3.95 and €4.05 billion, showing stable trajectory post-disposals versus €3.790 billion pro-forma 2024.
kpis.signal: Organic growth maintained despite strategic disposals.

kpis.name: Projected RLFCF 2025
kpis.explanation: Recurring raised free cash flow expected in 2025 post-disposals and after share buyback.
kpis.description: 2025 RLFCF projected between €1.9 and €1.95 billion, up versus €1.707 billion pro-forma 2024, demonstrating quality of remaining cash flow.
kpis.signal: Cash flow acceleration with double-digit growth despite size reduction from disposals.

ai_positioning.summary: Cellnex makes no mention of strategic initiatives related to artificial intelligence in recent reports. Its business remains focused on physical telecom infrastructure (antennas, fiber, small cells).
evidence: No mention of AI in 2024 results
No references to AI projects or cloud computing in business segments
Exclusive focus on organic infrastructure growth and debt management
